_doc: Placeholder ship lines for the nine factions with no designed ships (owner, 2026-11-08: "generate place holders for all of their ships, class design is your discretion"). Written by tools/factions/placeholder_fleets.py; built by docs/mockups/lib/placeholder-hulls.js; shown on mockup 36 (docs/mockups/placeholder-fleets.html). Profiles run stern (t 0) to bow (t 1); limb paths are in fractions of (half-beam, half-height, half-length). Placeholders until each faction's ship mockup replaces them; the armament is a role sketch, not tuning.
